answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake for weeks and build a verified history of completed work before it can earn trust. One fake identity is cheap, but funding thousands, each with its own stake and track record, soon costs more than any reward. Like an orchard that bears fruit only after seasons of tending, reputation must be grown, not cloned; a tundra of idle identities stays barren with no stake or history. Random peer audits that slash dishonest stakes keep even a light zephyr of newcomers honest, since a Sybil swarm cannot fake both capital and time.
